sources.title: LightOnOCR-3 released: 0.8B/1B/4B open models… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: LightOn released LightOnOCR-3, going beyond OCR with a single model handling text transcription, document layout analysis, image descriptions, and chart extraction. Three sizes are available—0.8B, 1B, and 4B—all under Apache 2.0. Researcher antoinechaffin endorsed the release, noting parsing is now built in.
